metadata.title: Frank Gore - Does grunt work in win
metadata.description: Gore played nine offensive snaps and four special-teams snaps in the Bills' 41-31 win over the Lions last Thursday night.
metadata.analysis: Gore did not appear in the box score, but the running back was a frequent pass blocker for Josh Allen in the Bills' offense. The practice squad elevation also participated in kick and punt coverage as he managed his role as the No. 3 running back in Ty Johnson's (hamstring) absence.

metadata.title: Frank Gore - Elevated to active roster
metadata.description: The Bills elevated Gore from the practice squad to the active roster for Thursday's game versus Detroit.
metadata.analysis: With Ty Johnson (hamstring) unavailable for Sunday's 36-31 win over the Texans, Gore was elevated to the active roster for that contest. He logged 11 offensive snaps, though he finished with just one carry for three yards. Gore's workload likely won't be much different against the Lions, so his elevation from the practice squad is mostly for depth purposes and seems to strongly suggest Johnson is in line to miss another game Thursday.

metadata.title: Frank Gore - Reverts to practice squad
metadata.description: Gore reverted to the practice squad after recording one carry for three yards in Buffalo's 36-31 win over Houston on Sunday, according to the NFL's official transaction log.
metadata.analysis: The running back played on 11 offensive snaps and four special-teams snaps. Gore was elevated for Week 1 because Ty Johnson was dealing with a hamstring injury. If Johnson can play in Week 2, it seems unlikely that Gore will be elevated again.

metadata.title: Frank Gore Jr. elevated from practice squad
metadata.description: Frank Gore Jr. has been elevated from the Bills' practice squad ahead of their game against the Texans.
metadata.analysis: Gore will provide depth and likely see some snaps on special teams, but is unlikely to see any real action on offense given the running backs ahead of him on the depth chart.

metadata.title: Frank Gore - Elevated for Sunday
metadata.description: The Bills elevated Gore from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.
metadata.analysis: Gore has been a practice squad staple for the Bills over the past two years. The running back has likely been elevated to the active roster as a depth precaution for a scenario in which Ty Johnson (hamstring) cannot suit up for Sunday's game against the Texans. If Johnson is good to go, Gore will likely be inactive on game day.

metadata.title: Frank Gore - Back on Bills' practice squad
metadata.description: Gore signed to Buffalo's practice squad Monday, Alec White and Mike Maynard of the team's official site report.
metadata.analysis: Gore has spent his entire career with Buffalo to this point, but he's yet to log any regular-season action. The Southern Miss product did, however, have a limited role in both of Buffalo's playoff contests last year. Gore seems likely to spend most of the 2026 campaign on the practice squad unless injuries hit Buffalo's running back corps.

metadata.title: Frank Gore Jr. signs future deal with Bills
metadata.description: The Bills signed RB Frank Gore Jr. to a future contract.
metadata.analysis: Gore spent this past season on the Bills practice squad. He will remain with them heading into their offseason program.

metadata.title: Frank Gore - Signs reserve/future deal with Bills
metadata.description: Buffalo signed Gore to a reserve/future contract Monday.
metadata.analysis: Gore has yet to log a regular-season NFL snap, but he got into both of Buffalo's postseason games this year, tallying four snaps on offense and 10 on special teams while recording one catch for six yards. The Southern Miss product will remain with the organization and will get an opportunity to compete for a roster spot ahead of the 2026 campaign.

metadata.title: Frank Gore - Elevated Friday
metadata.description: Buffalo elevated Gore from the practice squad Friday.
metadata.analysis: With Ty Johnson's (ankle) status in question for Saturday's divisional-round game against the Broncos, Gore will again have a chance to play behind James Cook and Ray Davis. Gore made his non-exhibition NFL debut last Sunday against the Jaguars, catching his lone target for six yards while playing four offensive snaps.

metadata.title: Frank Gore - Lands back on practice squad
metadata.description: The Bills reverted Gore to their practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
metadata.analysis: Ty Johnson (ankle) missed Sunday's wild-card win over Jacksonville, giving Gore an opportunity to log his first non-preseason NFL action as a pro. Gore ended up playing four offensive snaps, catching his only target for six yards. If Johnson is unable to return to action for Saturday's divisional-round matchup against Denver, Gore could be elevated again, though he'd be well behind James Cook and Ray Davis in the RB pecking order.
